content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Bitcoin payments for digital downloads represent a paradigm shift in how creators can monetize their work without reliance on conventional payment processors. With NOWPayments, transactions can be completed with a mere 0.5% fee compared to Gumroad's 10%. This difference means more revenue for creators, allowing them to reinvest in their work and grow their businesses more sustainably. When you understand the fundamental changes that Bitcoin brings to digital commerce, you position yourself ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving marketplace.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Bitcoin payments for digital downloads involves several key components working in harmony. Using platforms like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the payment verification and product delivery process. When a customer pays in Bitcoin, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain, triggering the automated delivery of the digital product through services like Google Drive. This seamless integration eliminates the need for traditional payment gateways while ensuring that you have full control over your sales and customer data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment systems fail. If you are selling ebooks, courses, or templates and are tired of losing a significant portion of your earnings to platform fees, this architecture is for you. It allows for complete ownership of your business infrastructure, meaning you are not just a user of a service—you are the owner of your entire commerce stack. Creators in Nigeria, Kenya, and other regions facing payment restrictions can benefit immensely from this independent setup.
NOWPayments drastically reduces transaction fees compared to traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A successful Bitcoin payment system for digital downloads consists of several essential components: a hosting platform like GitHub Pages, backend logic via Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments for crypto verification. By utilizing free tools like Supabase for order storage and Google Drive for product delivery, you can create a robust and scalable environment. This infrastructure ensures that your customers consistently receive their purchases promptly while you maintain complete ownership and control over your data and operations.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your Bitcoin payment system for selling digital downloads, begin by selecting the Sovereign Starter Stack for a quick setup. Next, integrate NOWPayments to handle Bitcoin transactions, ensuring you configure your delivery methods through either Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test the entire system to confirm that payments are processed and products are delivered automatically. Once operational, you can start promoting your digital products without worrying about platform restrictions or excessive fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a Bitcoin payment processor like NOWPayments. This setup allows you to retain a larger percentage of your sales, as NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee. By leveraging automated delivery systems, you can effectively manage transactions and product distributions without relying on conventional payment platforms.
Complete ownership of your digital commerce stack means no platform dependencies.

If you're looking for comprehensive solutions to create your digital storefront, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates necessary for building your sovereign commerce stack. This kit simplifies the entire setup process, allowing you to focus on your products. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell an ebook online by using a Bitcoin payment processor like NOWPayments. By integrating this with a hosting solution, you can automate the payment and delivery process, allowing you to operate independently of traditional payment platforms.

Using NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions is the best way to sell digital downloads without significant platform fees. It only charges a 0.5% fee compared to higher fees from platforms like Gumroad, giving you more revenue.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by setting up a Bitcoin payment system with NOWPayments. This allows for automated transactions and product delivery without relying on traditional marketplaces.
What do I need to set up my digital product store?

To set up your digital product store, you need a hosting platform like GitHub Pages, a payment processor like NOWPayments, and a method for product delivery, such as Google Drive. This infrastructure will enable you to operate independently.
Can I automate delivery of my digital products?

Yes, you can automate the delivery of your digital products using services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools allow you to trigger product delivery as soon as a payment is confirmed.
